about_the_game:
Just a ball, with dreams in the Stratosphere.

Jump to Stratos is a rage inducing platformer where your goal is to rise from the bottom to the top in this cyberpunk city. Stratos is a race, a challenging one at that, sure you can take it slow and methodical and get to the top (if you can!), but the fun comes from seeing just how fast you can go and more importantly boasting how much better you are than your friends.

Gameplay:

– Jump to survive!

The only way to climb is to jump but every jump comes with a risk of falling, every jump is different and you must line up the correct angle and power so you don't miss, otherwise you have a long way to fall.

– Rolling, Rolling, Rolling!

Remember you're a ball, and balls roll! So when you get onto your next platform, if you're not ready to jump straight away, you better stop yourself from falling before it's too late…

–Obstacles Wipeout!

Just as you thought it was just jumping! You will face many obstacles along your path each with a unique way of making your experience just that little bit harder, make sure you understand how each device works before taking that next jump or you may be smacking into the ground.

Setting:

–Location

You are placed in a Cyberpunk sprawl with multiple city levels, factories and more. You will climb up through the cities on race platforms perfectly placed so every jump is possible but also ragefully hard. 

–People

Just when you thought all the Jumping and Falling was hard you also have to deal with citizens yelling things while you try to focus. Some are supportive, some are not, others wonder how you were allowed into their factory.

–Race

These platforms weren’t cheap! And the Stratos race is a huge event where pilots use the Robots to jump through the city and attempt to get to the end in the best time. Some people love the race, while some just want to be left alone, no matter what though everyone's talking about it!

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: 2 GHz Dual Core CPU
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Integrated or dedicated graphics with DirectX 11 support
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 1 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system

short_description: Every jump is a risk and every fall is a punishment in this cyberpunk city, do you have what it takes to complete this upwards struggle one jump at a time, but be careful one mistimed leap or tricky device can send you into a long fall down!
